name: project-memory
description: Durable project memory as markdown pages on disk: BM25F search, validated writes, no server.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code tool mapping for the project-memory skill:

- The skill calls two scripts through the shell. Use Kimi Code's `Bash` tool to run them; there is no MCP server and no other transport.
- When the skill says to read a page in full, use `Read` on the path that search printed, not another search.
- When a write is rejected, the script exits non-zero and prints a `FIX:` line naming the exact command to run. Follow that line; do not work around the rejection by writing the markdown file directly with `Write`.
- The store is `.memory/` at the repository root, or `$PROJECT_MEMORY_DIR` when set.

interface.shortDescription: Searchable project memory: why the code is the way it is
interface.longDescription: Keeps decisions, contracts and bug post-mortems as markdown pages in .memory/, searchable with BM25F ranking and no server. Reads before you explore an unfamiliar subsystem; writes after a non-obvious fix.
